services.name: layoutLoop
services.sig: export function layoutLoop(loop, { width, textWidth, nodeH = 26, rowGap = 22, colGap = 56 })
services.doc: A dependency cycle as a racetrack: down the left column, a turn at the bottom, up the right column, a turn at the top. Every step is part of the same circuit (no special "return" edge) and every arrowhead is axis-aligned. Two-step loops are two boxes side by side, joined by an arc over the top and one under the bottom.
